name: launchpad-cli
description: Standalone, agent-friendly Rust CLI for Launchpad

scripts.check:release: node --check scripts/release-metadata.mjs && node --check scripts/package-release.mjs && node --check scripts/release-checksums.mjs
scripts.check: npm run openapi:check && npm run check:release && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
